Subject: Waitlist conversion — quick ask on trial top-ups

Hi Irene,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — team loved the latency comparison graphs. We have ~120 people from our webinar waitlist who signed up for a guided trial. We wanted to check whether you can provide a short trial-bridge (10k token credits) for each of the top 30 accounts to accelerate POC momentum.

What we need to confirm:
- Is a one-off promo allocation of 300k tokens (30 x 10k) possible on a single deal?
- Any limits on per-account activation windows?
- If we need to stagger rollouts, can we get a CSV with unique redeem codes and expiration dates?

If helpful, I can share the list (we prefer codes rather than blanket account credits). We aim to convert by end of Q3.

Appreciate a quick thumbs-up if this is doable.

Best,
Samira
Head of Growth, Nimbus Analytics

Nice ask — this is high-leverage if we can close 8–10 of the 30. A few notes:
- Promo codes are our preferred flow here (easier for partner ops). We can generate 30 single-use codes with 30-day expiry.
- Standard internal cap for promotional credits without exec signoff is 200k tokens (~$X). Their request is 300k, so we need an exception.
- Suggestion: approve 200k now, require sales commit (NDA/contract) to unlock remaining 100k on executed MSA or PO. That reduces risk.

Karthik — can you run credit impact and confirm whether the code generation UI supports unique per-email redemption? If yes, I'll draft the partner-facing email and include the codes.

Marissa
Sr. Account Exec, Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Sep 2025 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Waitlist conversion — quick ask on trial top-ups

On Mon, 31 Aug 2025, Marissa Cole wrote:
> - Promo codes are our preferred flow here (easier for partner ops). We can generate 30 single-use codes with 30-day expiry.
> - Standard internal cap for promotional credits without exec signoff is 200k tokens (~$X). Their request is 300k, so we need an exception.

Checked with billing/ops:
- We can generate 30 single-use promo codes, one code per email, 30-day TTL. Backend supports single redemption tracking.
- Cost impact estimate: 300k tokens is ~ $1,350 unit cost to Redwood (approx). Approving 200k reduces the immediate exposure to ~$900.
- If we require contractual milestone to unlock remaining 100k, we can implement an automated release when a HubSpot deal stage moves to "Contract Sent" or when a signed DocuSign is received (we have a webhook).

I'll prepare the promo batch and a CSV template for redemption mapping once Marissa confirms approval path.

Karthik
Head of Sales Ops

Samira — great to hear the demo landed well. Quick plan below: 

1) We will provision 20 x 10k redeemable promo codes (200k tokens) for immediate distribution to your top waitlist accounts. Codes will be single-use, 30-day expiry.
2) The remaining 10 codes (100k tokens) can be released automatically once Nimbus executes the MSA or provides a signed PO. We can wire the release to a DocuSign event.
3) Attached is a short CSV with the code mapping template and a brief how-to for recipients (redeem via /account/promos).

Next steps for you: share the top-20 emails to map codes, and confirm who on your side will send the outreach. We'll generate the codes and return the CSV + a short recipient-facing note you can paste into your outreach.

If that works, I'll spin up the promo batch first thing tomorrow.

Best,
Marissa
Sr. Account Exec, Redwood Inference
